A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work. Their main text, equations, algorithms, tables, figures, and Appendix A are readable and can be matched despite substantial reformatting.

before.justification: V2 reports original label-propagation experiments on synthetic key-value, news article, and LLM agent datasets, including Tables 1–4 and appendix sensitivity analyses.

after.justification: V3 retains these original experimental results, including the three datasets, output-alignment measurements, and Appendix A grid searches.

M1.justification: Algorithm 1, the prompt-based and kNN-LM implementations, the output-regeneration wrapper, and Appendix A’s Shapley pruning heuristic are unchanged. Splitting the initialization and loop onto separate pseudocode lines changes formatting only.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same synthetic personal-information questions, paired high/low-integrity news questions, and agent conversations using web, email, and calendar retrieval. Appendix A retains the same dataset coverage.

E2.justification: Tables 1 and 3 retain the same introspection comparisons, and Table 1 retains the kNN-LM alternative. The newly cited security and attribution methods are not added as evaluated comparators.

E3.justification: The Llama-2 model configurations, dataset sizes, retrieval settings, metrics, and hyperparameter grids are unchanged. Both versions use 14-document synthetic contexts, 63 questions for the introspection baseline, and an agent-experiment threshold of lambda = 0.2.

E4.justification: Both retain the model-size and retriever comparisons, perplexity-tolerance sensitivity plots, ground-truth versus generated-output analysis, and Appendix A’s Shapley-threshold grid searches. No analytical question or supporting experiment is added or removed.

E5.justification: Table 1 retains the same reporting of means and one standard deviation for macro-averaged precision and recall. Neither version adds run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–4 and the appendix heatmaps match, and the plotted trends and reported findings are retained. For example, synthetic exact match remains 85.94% for both prompt-based model sizes, and agent label improvement remains 85.0% and 95.0%.

T1.justification: Definition 1, Equations 1–4, the monotonicity assumption, Proposition 1, and their supporting reasoning are unchanged. Mathematical typesetting and pseudocode line numbering do not alter the formal content.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about permissive propagation, safety, and output quality. V3 makes the input-label assumption explicit in the abstract, but that assumption already appears in v2’s Section 2.1.

C2.justification: The interpretations of model-size effects, retrieval errors, and regenerated-output alignment remain unchanged. The same applicability discussion and limitations concerning computational cost, nonmonotonic utility, and adversarial degradation are retained.

D1.justification: V3 removes v2’s Open Science statement promising release of the prototype implementation and evaluation datasets, without providing replacement access information. This removes release-related disclosure; it does not establish that previously available resources were withdrawn. Experimental implementation details remain unchanged.

R1.justification: V3 adds references to Verma et al., Attribot, and agent-security work by Costa et al., Debenedetti et al., and Zhong et al. Sections 3.5, 6.3, and 7 briefly extend the efficiency context and distinguish propagation through LLM calls from security enforcement around agent tools.

P1.justification: V3 makes limited wording refinements, adds publication and author-contact information, and switches to author-year citations. V2’s Open Science and Ethics Considerations sections disappear, while the wording and organization of Sections 1–8 and Appendix A remain largely intact.

P2.justification: The entire document changes from two columns to a single-column journal format, with extensive resizing and relocation of existing displays. Figures 7–8 are enlarged, Figures 9–10 precede the Appendix A heading, and Figure 6’s inner table now extends beyond its blue container. No scientific display is added or removed.

improvement.justification: The technical argument and empirical support remain unchanged. Clearer abstract wording and updated research positioning provide modest benefits, balanced by removal of the release disclosure and a new Figure 6 layout defect. Despite extensive reformatting, overall paper quality remains essentially stable.
